infobox.usage: Unlocks the door to the laboratory quarantine zone (G11) in The Lab.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: TerraGroup Labs keycard (Blue) (Blue) is a Keycard in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A United Security-issued TerraGroup Labs keycard for service personnel in the Blue sector.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - Only 5 can be held in a raid inventory at the same time

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- On Cultists
- On The Goons
- In Rare valuables crates

sections.heading: Customs
sections.text:
- On Partisan
- At the three-story dorms in the "marked room"
- At the "giving tree" behind the "Old Gas Station"

sections.heading: Reserve
sections.text:
- On Glukhar
- In the "marked rooms" RB-BK, RB-PKPM and RB-VO

sections.heading: Streets of Tarkov
sections.text:
- On Kaban
- In the "marked room" at the abandoned factory
- In the "marked room" at Chekannaya 13

sections.heading: Shoreline
sections.text:
- On Partisan
- On the step of the passenger side of the ambulance that is parked in front of the resort

- West Wing Office 104 in the resort: On a desk between lamp and files

Keycard on the desk

- West Wing Office 112 in the resort: On a lowboard bottom left of the TV

In front of West 112

Keycard next to the TV

- West wing room 325 in the resort: On the floor under the bed.

- West wing room 306 in the resort: On the sink in the bathroom.

- West wing room 219 in the resort: On the table. Note: Currently not possible to be picked up.

sections.heading: The Lab
sections.text:
- In Kruglov's office (R22) and the safe inside of it
- In the laboratory manager office (O21), on a lounge chair. TerraGroup Labs manager's office room key is required for entry.

- On the first level in the recreation area (R11), under a bench on the parking garage side.

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Laboratory quarantine zone (G11) on the first level in The Lab.

sections.heading: Behind The Lock
sections.text:
- Red keycard spawn location
- Possible LEDX Skin Transilluminator spawn on shelves
- 2× Medcases
- Loose loot (Meds, Medical supplies)
